googleMaps.plugin.title: Google Maps
googleMaps.plugin.summary: Maps, place search and routes outside mainland China use Google Maps (Google Maps Platform; enter two keys in Settings · Data sources · Google Maps: a browser key and a server key), with transit and live traffic for driving. You can also pick it by hand in the map switch, in China too (coordinates are converted automatically). Disabled or removed, it falls back to OpenStreetMap
googleMaps.plugin.purge.keys: The two Google keys you entered
googleMaps.plugin.purge.usage: The monthly counts of Google requests and whether going over the free usage is allowed
googleMaps.plugin.keep.chat: Places mentioned in chats (that's chat history)
googleMaps.source.title: Google Maps
googleMaps.source.summary: With keys entered, the map page uses Google Maps outside mainland China, and so do place and route lookups there (only the start, the end or the "nearby" spot is sent to Google when you ask, and results aren't stored). The server key stays on this computer; where you go each day and where your photos were taken are never sent to Google
googleMaps.source.disconnectNote: Both keys are deleted from this computer (they still exist in Google Cloud — delete them there if you're done); the map and lookups outside China switch to OpenStreetMap
googleMaps.provider.title: Google Maps
googleMaps.doctor.usage.title: Google Maps usage
googleMaps.doctor.usage.noKey: No Google key entered; Google Maps isn't used
googleMaps.doctor.usage.near: Close to Google's free usage in {month}: {items} (requests / monthly free usage)
googleMaps.doctor.usage.over: Over Google's free usage in {month} ({over}); that part is paused and OpenStreetMap is used instead: {items}
googleMaps.doctor.usage.overAllowed: Over Google's free usage in {month} ({over}); you allowed it, so Google bills the extra: {items}
googleMaps.doctor.usage.fixNear: Use it a little less this month; check the actual usage, budget alerts and daily caps in the Google Cloud console
googleMaps.doctor.usage.fixOver: It resumes next month; to keep using it now, allow it in Settings · Data sources · Google Maps (Google bills the extra)
googleMaps.doctor.usage.fixOverAllowed: To avoid extra charges, turn off "keep using after the free usage" in Settings · Data sources · Google Maps and set daily caps in Google Cloud
googleMaps.error.key: Google doesn't recognize this server key (mistyped, deleted, or from another project)
googleMaps.error.serviceDisabled: this API isn't enabled in the Google Cloud project yet: enable it under APIs & Services · Library
googleMaps.error.apiRestricted: this API isn't ticked in the key's API restrictions: edit the key under Credentials and tick it
googleMaps.error.appRestricted: the key's application restriction doesn't allow this computer: the server key should use "IP addresses" with this computer's public IP
googleMaps.error.billing: billing isn't enabled for this Google Cloud project (Google requires a billing account)
googleMaps.error.limit: Google says the usage limit was reached ({detail}): most likely the daily cap set in Google Cloud; try again tomorrow
googleMaps.error.browserRejected: Google rejected the browser key (wrong key, Maps JavaScript API not enabled, ergo's address missing from the website restrictions, or billing off): fix it and enter it again
googleMaps.problem.mapsOver: This month's free Google map loads are used up, so OpenStreetMap is used for now (it resumes next month, or allow it in Settings · Data sources · Google Maps)
googleMaps.problem.over: Over Google's free usage this month, paused: {items} (resumes next month, or allow it below)
googleMaps.configure.badKey: That doesn't look like a Google key: no spaces or line breaks — check whether you copied too much or too little
googleMaps.configure.nothing: Enter a key first: the browser key (maps) or the server key (places and routes), at least one
googleMaps.configure.keptOld: The new one didn't pass ({reason}); still using the old one
googleMaps.static.noKey: Google's server key isn't set (Settings · Data sources · Google Maps)
googleMaps.static.over: This month's free Google previews are used up (it resumes next month, or allow it in Settings · Data sources · Google Maps)
googleMaps.static.off: Google's Maps Static API isn't enabled (or the server key's API restrictions don't include it): enable and tick it in Google Cloud
